speaker: Narrator
text: For months, they had held the peninsula—as planned.

speaker: Narrator
text: Bataan… and Corregidor… waiting for a relief that never came.

speaker: Narrator
text: The Navy could not reach them. No reinforcements would arrive.

speaker: Narrator
text: Still, they fought—four months against an enemy better supplied, better fed, and never ordered to yield.

speaker: Narrator
text: The order had been clear: Hold

speaker: Narrator
text: But what remained… could no longer do so.
